newsitem.title: USA: Sport-Haley stake held by First Bank.
newsitem.headline: Sport-Haley stake held by First Bank.

text.p: Sport-Haley Inc said on Thursday that First Bank System Inc through various subsidiaries acquired 9.11 percent of the company's shares, making it Sport-Haley's largest institutional stakeholder.
Sport-Haley said First Bank's stake was acquired "in the ordinary course of business," and represented a vote of confidence in the golf apparel maker.
Sport-Haley said First Bank System filed a Schedule 13-G with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission indicating it held 403,600 Sport-Haley common shares.
Sport-Haley shares were trading at 18 early Thursday, unchanged on the day but just below their 52-week high of 18-1/4.
First Bank System, in a separate announcement, said on Thursday it agreed to acquire U.S. Bancorp in a deal worth about $9 billion.
